basic_profile.bio: A 35-year-old culinary researcher based in Seattle, passionate about understanding food intolerances, especially histamine intolerance. Enjoys hiking in the Pacific Northwest and experimenting with allergen-free recipes. Works as a freelance food writer and recipe developer. Single and dedicated to raising awareness about dietary restrictions. Typically online in the evenings and weekends, when not exploring the great outdoors.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Possesses a degree in Food Science from the University of Washington. Has spent over a decade researching histamine intolerance and dietary impacts, often self-teaching through extensive reading and experimentation. Regularly attends workshops and seminars on nutrition and food allergies.
